evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Customer volunteered a concern (not wanting to move themselves after moving five months ago) but rep never asked the structured two-concerns question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up depth. When customer said 'No, we just don't wanna move again, we don't wanna move it ourselves,' Nicole pivoted immediately to pricing without probing further.
evidence_quotes.value_days: No value days mentioned. Saturday was confirmed as available but no discussion of pricing differences by day or date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rate lock and no deposit mentioned ('to secure a spot, there's no deposit required') but the ask itself was weak and indirect: 'And would you like me to get you on the schedule?' with no affirmative response captured before customer objected on price.

top_strength: Nicole established strong rapport, collected detailed logistics systematically (property type, square footage, room count, appliances, TVs, parking access, box count), and delivered a clear all-inclusive pricing framing with confidence and no hidden fees disclosure.
coaching_note: Never asked the two-concerns question at the start of step 2, missing the opportunity to surface and validate what actually mattered to this customer before pivoting to pricing; when price objection came, there was no step 6 final concerns check or salvage attempt, so the call ended without addressing whether the estimate itself was the barrier or whether the customer needed help seeing value.
